answer: Deposits are visible in inlet, and comet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 65 aliases, and each one needs its own funded copper account. A bond of 45% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2568 identities would post 4593 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
